summary: Woman killed on Crosier Mountain on the first day of 2026; Glen Haven fire, Estes Park police, Larimer County agencies, coroner, and CPW responded; LCSAR assisted.
responding_agency: Larimer County Search and Rescue; Glen Haven Area Volunteer Fire Department; Estes Park Police Department; Larimer County Natural Resources; Larimer County Coroner's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Reposted sheriff-support post; nature of the fatal injury unspecified in the post. Coroner release identifies victim as Kristen Marie Kovatch, 46, of Fort Collins; cause Asphyxia due to External Neck Compression (mountain lion attack, ruled Accident).
